categories.label: Retail
categories.words: Up to ₹2 lakh. SME lots are large, so one lot may be all there is.
categories.odds_words: About 1 in 2 applicants gets one lot (an estimate, from 1.9x bids).

categories.label: Small HNI (sHNI)
categories.words: More than ₹2 lakh, up to ₹10 lakh.
categories.odds_words: About 1 in 3 applicants gets the smallest application (an estimate, from 3.0x bids).

categories.label: Big HNI (bHNI)
categories.odds_words: About 1 in 5 applicants gets the smallest application (an estimate, from 5.2x bids).

odds_note: From the latest bids. They usually jump on the last day, so the odds will fall.

verdicts.track_words: No track record yet: past IPOs haven't been tested with today's rules.

exits.title: If you apply anyway
steps: The checks don't suggest applying for either goal. If you still want to, write your reason in the journal first.
Use the listing-day rule: decide before Wed 4 Nov what you'll do if it opens above or below ₹80.

disclaimer: A learning aid worked out by fixed rules, not advice. Only apply with money you won't need soon, and decide for yourself.
